data.long_meaning: In Russian, Gavrila means 'Gabriel's messenger'. This name is derived from the name Gabriel, which means 'God is my strong one'. Gavrila is a powerful and spiritual name, suggesting a strong connection to faith and the divine. The name Gavrila carries the meaning “Gabriel's messenger” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Gavrila usually hope their child will grow to embody gabriel's messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: גברילה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גברילה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא כוחי' או 'חזק ואדיר'. השם נגזר מהמילים 'גבר' שפירושו חזק או אדיר, ו'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. השם גברילה מופיע בתנךך ככינויו של מלאך, אחד משמות המלאכים המופיעים בספר דניאל.

in_greek.name: Γαβριήλα
in_greek.long_meaning: Γαβριήλα προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου' ή 'ισχυρός Θεός'. Το όνομα Γαβριήλ προέρχεται από τις λέξεις 'גבר' (gabhar) που σημαίνει ισχυρός και 'אל' (El) που σημαίνει Θεός. Στο Χριστιανισμό, ο Γαβριήλ είναι ο άγγελος που ανακοίνωσε τη γέννηση του Ιησού Χριστού στη Μαρία.

in_latin.name: Gabrila
in_latin.long_meaning: Gabrila, derivata ebraice, significat 'Deus est fortitudo mea' vel 'Deus est meus robur'. Nomen Gabrila provenit ex verbis hebraicis 'גבר' (gabhar), quod significat robustus, et 'אל' (El), quod significat Deus. In traditione christiana, Gabrila est angelus qui nuntiavit natale Jesu Christi.

in_english.name: Gavrila
in_english.meaning: God is my strength or Mighty one
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gavrila originates from Hebrew, meaning 'God is my strength' or 'Mighty one'. Derived from 'גבר' (gabhar) meaning strong or mighty and 'אל' (El) meaning God, Gavrila signifies divine power and protection. In Christian tradition, Gavrila is associated with the Archangel Gabriel, known for announcing Jesus Christ's birth to Mary. The name symbolizes spiritual strength and courage.

Gavrila Derzhinsky was a famous composer known for his patriotic music. In folklore, Gavrila is also depicted as a guardian angel and a protector of the common people.
data.spiritual_significance: Gavrila is a deeply spiritual name, evoking images of messengers and angels bringing the message of God to the world. The name suggests a strong faith and a deep connection to the divine, invoking the power and protection of the Archangel Gabriel. The name is a reminder that we are all messengers of God, called to bring love, hope, and faith to those around us.
